0      Consideration of Bid #E-21-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
              and ABM Industry Groups, LLC, for Janitorial Services for the City of Cheyenne
              — Cheyenne Municipal Court. (General Fund)

Mr. Esquibel moved to accept the bid in an amount not to exceed $91,926.72, seconded by Mr.
Moody. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report.

       g)     Consideration of Bid #E-22-25 for furnishing an Automatic Tarping Machine for
              the City of Cheyenne Landfill. (Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Roybal moved to accept the bid from Tarpomatic Inc., Canton, Ohio, in an amount not to
exceed $93,060.00, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report.

       h)     Consideration of Bid #S-24-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
              and Climate Control LLC, for HVAC and Mechanical Systems Maintenance.
              (2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund, Civic Center Fund, Fleet Maintenance
              Fund, General Fund, Solid Waste Fund, Ice and Events Center Fund and Recreation
              Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to accept the bid in an amount not to exceed $1,446,167.00, seconded by Mr.
Esquibel. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report. Committee members Moody
and Roybal commented on the item.

       i)     Consideration of Bid #S-25-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
              and Pro Coatings, Inc., for the Spiker Garage Interior Painting Project. (2021
              Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to accept the bid in an amount not to exceed $253,527.00, seconded by Mr.
Esquibel. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director, provided a staff report. Chairman
Laybourn and committee members Esquibel and Moody commented on the item.
